content: अभिघातः .²1 Striking, (<ab>fig.</ab> also); beating, smiting, attack, injury, hurt; तटाभिघातादिव लग्नपङ्के <ls>Ku. 7. 49</ls>; शीतातपाभिघातान् <ls>Ms. 12. 77</ls> attacks of heat and cold; so दुःख˚, शोक˚ <ab>&c.</ab> .²2 (In Vaiśeṣika <ab>Phil.</ab>) Striking against (such as gives rise to sounds <ab>&c.</ab>), regarded as a kind of संयोग. .²3 Striking back, driving or warding off. .²4 Extirpation, complete destruction or removal; दुःखत्रयाभिघाताज्जिज्ञासा तदभिघातके हेतौ <ls>Sāṅ. K. 1</ls>. .²5 Abrupt or vehement articulation of words (as of Vedic texts); sudden shock. .{@-तम्@} .²1 The combination of the 4th letter of any class with the first or third letter of that class; of the second with the first; and of the third with the second letter of any class; अभिघातं स्यात्पूर्वं वेदद्वित्र्यादिवर्णाश्चेत् . नववर्गाणां नवतो धरणीचन्द्रद्विरामाद्याः <ls>Śabdak.</ls> .²2 A harsh pronunciation caused by the neglect of {%Sandhi%} rules.
